newsitem.title: DENMARK: Swedish criticism of royal smoking enrages Denmark.
newsitem.headline: Swedish criticism of royal smoking enrages Denmark.

text.p: Scathing criticism by a Swedish journalist of Danish Queen Margrethe's smoking habits lit a storm of fury in Denmark on Wednesday with tabloid newspapers slamming Swedes for "double standards" and "hypocrisy."
"Smoke War against the Swedes", roared popular tabloid Ekstra Bladet across its front page, "Let the Queen Smoke in Peace" read the headline of an article inside the daily.
"Mind your own business, Sweden", "Keep up the puffing, Margrethe", were other newspaper headlines.
The controversy was triggered by veteran Swedish columnist Hagge Geigert in Saturday's Gothenburg Post.
He launched a strong attack on the chain-smoking Danish monarch for being "a living advertisement for cancer-inducing" tobacco and setting the public a bad example.
"The Danish queen has her own special servant who follows her around with an ashtray. She smokes everywhere even in care centres," Geigert wrote.
"I think it is totally wrong for the queen to smoke in public buildings where smoking is normally banned," he said.
In contrast, Sweden's King Carl XVI Gustaf was never seen smoking in photographs or television, Geigert wrote.
The Danish tabloid press was enraged by Geigert's comments, denouncing Swedes for double standards, an American-style prohibition mentality and blatant hypocrisy.
"Is it a sign of responsibility for the Swedish king to slink off to the toilets to have a drag on the sly?", Ekstra Bladet thundered.

The royal court in Copenhagen has refused any official comment but chamberlain Soeren Haslund-Christensen said: "The public attitude in Denmark is that it is entirely up to the queen herself whether she smokes or not."
"It is a private matter whether the queen wants to smoke or not," Ninna Wuertzen, head of the Danish Cancer Society said.

The latest bout of anti-Swedish hysteria in Denmark comes a week before Queen Margrethe, 56, a second cousin of Britain's Queen Elizabeth, celebrates the 25th anniversary of her accession to the Danish throne with festivities to be attended by Nordic royalty.
